cd /workspace/project && timeout 300 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,urllib.parse,time
now=int(time.time()); wk=now-8*86400
def hn(q):
    u=f"https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search_by_date?query={urllib.parse.quote(q)}&tags=story&numericFilters=created_at_i>{wk}&hitsPerPage=15"
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=35) as x: return json.load(x).get("hits",[])
    except Exception: return []
terms=["Show HN GPU cloud","Show HN VPS","Show HN sandbox code execution","Show HN containers",
       "Show HN serverless","Show HN credits","free tier launch","Show HN hosting","Show HN inference"]
seen=set()
for t in terms:
    for h in hn(t):
        title=h.get("title") or ""; url=h.get("url") or ""
        if not title or url in seen: continue
        low=title.lower()
        if not any(k in low for k in ["gpu","vps","sandbox","container","serverless","host","inference","credit","free","vm","deploy"]): continue
        seen.add(url)
        print(f"[{h.get('created_at','')[:10]}] {title[:78]}\n     {url[:100]}")
PY
